name: 菌子消消乐 · 开始按钮修订
promptText: Two clear rounded wooden xylophone notes rising in pitch, played briskly as one cheerful confirmation chime. Full audible notes with a compact natural decay. Clean isolated game interface sound, consistent volume, no voice or background noise.

name: 菌子消消乐 · 进入关卡修订
promptText: Wooden marimba notification chime: three distinct ascending mellow notes, evenly spaced, bright and clearly audible, ending in a warm resonant chord with a short gentle decay. A cheerful ready-to-play game UI cue. Clean close recording, balanced levels, no background noise, no voice.
